overview_description.description: baraka is an investment app, founded in the UAE. It empowers people to become confident investors by providing educational content, digestible market news and in-depth stock analysis. Access to thousands of stocks and ETFs creates the freedom to explore new opportunities. baraka’s mission: to give everyone access to the markets, and empower everyone to invest. It’s what they call: investing. empowered.

about_short_description.short_description: Baraka is an investment app offering commission-free trading and financial education.

product.name: Investment Platform
product.description: A digital platform enabling GCC investors to invest in over 6,000 U.S. stocks and ETFs with execution-only services.

product.name: Auto-Invest
product.description: A feature that automates recurring investments to help users invest regularly without manual deposits or timing.

product.name: Stock Analysis & Reports
product.description: Access to detailed stock analysis and reports with analyst estimates on share price movements from LSEG.

product.name: Income Center
product.description: A tool to track earned income from dividends on stocks, REITs, and bond ETFs within the user's portfolio.

product.name: Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP)
product.description: A plan that allows reinvestment of cash dividends into additional shares or fractional shares automatically.

product.name: Sharia Screener
product.description: A screening tool that filters stocks to align investments with Sharia principles for compliant investing.
